main.remarks: When is supplied, creates a signed envelope; otherwise it creates an unsigned envelope.

property.name: AccessKeyRealmID
property.summary: Optional access-key realm identifier serialized into the encrypted payload and used in AAD.

property.name: Assertions
property.summary: Optional assertions to embed in the encrypted payload.

property.name: Audiences
property.summary: Optional intended audiences. Null or empty means no audience restriction.

property.name: IssuerAccessManagerID
property.summary: Guid identifying the issuing AccessManager instance.

property.name: IssuerToolID
property.summary: Guid identifying the issuing tool instance.

property.name: Lifetime
property.summary: Optional lifetime for expiry; if null or less than or equal to zero then the token does not expire.

property.name: ManifestHash
property.summary: Optional manifest hash serialized as a fixed 64-byte SHA-512 digest decoded from its hexadecimal form.

property.name: Operations
property.summary: Sequence of protected-operation indices to authorize.

property.name: Scopes
property.summary: Optional higher-level scope claims. Null or empty means no scope claims are issued.

property.name: Signer
property.summary: Optional signer used to create a signed outer envelope. Null produces an unsigned envelope.

property.name: Subject
property.summary: Subject string serialized into the encrypted payload.

property.name: ToolSchemaID
property.summary: Optional tool schema identifier serialized into the encrypted payload and used in AAD.
